resources.string: Off · warn each other about spam callers

When someone in %1$s blocks a number or calls it a scam, your phone can warn you when that number calls you.

What's shared: the numbers you block one by one, and the ones you mark as a scam or spam, each with its date and the member it came from. Never names, notes or your calls.

Each number travels as a code made with this label's key, so nobody outside the label can tell which number it is. People in the label can work it out, so share only what you'd tell them.

Your saved contacts and emergency numbers always ring.
